state: Evidence gathering; no autonomous learning or reliable uplift measured

plannedResearch.feature: Handicap mark versus last achieved figure
plannedResearch.source: BHA ratings database and performance figures
plannedResearch.method: Save historic weekly ratings with immutable observation dates; compare published pre-event mark and achieved past figures, controlling for trip/going. Do not compare with retrospective ratings revisions without timestamps.

plannedResearch.source: Racing TV in-running position, attributable results and stewards
plannedResearch.method: Tagged leader/prominent/midfield/closer from last six sourced runs; demand >=3 style observations with >=60% agreement or mark unknown.
plannedResearch.impact: Unknown until licensed historical comments imported

plannedResearch.source: Prior-run style of every declared horse
plannedResearch.method: Only show a race map when >=4 styles known and >=60% coverage of field; three+ confirmed front-runners suggests pace competition, no certainty.

plannedResearch.source: Verified racecourse and distance-specific course maps
plannedResearch.method: Model bend count, first-turn distance, straight length, gradient, rails, field size, surface and going separately. Require >=40 comparable historical races before quantifying biases.

plannedResearch.source: BHA steward reports and published factual race notes
plannedResearch.method: Tag documented slow starts, hampering, wide trips, lost shoes, lameness, late strength, easing and jumping mistakes with source and incident date; no automatic improvement bonus.
Use finishing speed % relative to actual par for same track/trip/going, not universal FSP threshold; never extrapolate unavailable fractions.

plannedResearch.source: Dated full-field historical results plus saved pre-race predictions
plannedResearch.method: No training with <500 distinct historical races and <2,000 sourced field runners. Forward-chain by race date; keep all runners in each race together. Compare Brier/log loss to timestamped market baseline; report ROI with realistic odds and uncertainty.
